opening.argument: The speaker plainly endorses OneCoin, stating, "I'm all about supporting one coin," while describing paid education as producing mining tokens and noting that "people are putting thousands and thousands of dollars into OneCoin." He also presents recruitment and continued business-building as the path forward, saying, "we can sign people up from other countries, and continue the business going." Finally, he favorably frames the opportunity through claims that its leaders can "bring back the wealth back to the people of the world." Taken together, these are promotional claims about paid participation, recruiting, cryptocurrency value, and restoring wealth—not a warning against involvement.
